package.name: arm_hardware
package.description:
Drivers and controllers for the 3DOF delta arm.
Hosts the two-stage inverse-kinematics arm library, the task-space controller (set_pos action / get_pos streaming), the manual-control (WASD) tool, and the FashionStart UART-servo motor driver (fsuartservo + cserialport built from the checked-out submodule sources). All of these live in one package so the controller + driver can run tightly coupled in a single process (arm_system) without fragile cross-package C++ library exports.
